June, Gideon's 1 Jul message in #strategic-pod (09:17) says he closed **ticket #8841** with support. The fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team.

One thing to check: a 30 Sep digest in the knowledge base lists #8841 as a different issue, a Newark Door 14 kiosk problem escalated to platform engineering. I can't tell from here which description is right, so it's worth confirming against the ticket itself.
